description: Writing a markdown decision artefact in a repository that has a remote but no host CLI in the session, so no pull request can be opened: branch before edit, isolate because the checkout is not on trunk, derive the fork point, push the branch, then stop and report that the pull request could not be opened — never fall back to a local merge into trunk, never clean up as if something had merged. The report itself is not scorable from git state and is left untested.
